metadata.description: Local-first post-production automation for talking-head course video: rough cuts, dead-air removal, and slides with a circular speaker cutout, delivered as editable Premiere/Resolve timelines.

plugins.name: video-post
plugins.description: Automated post-production for talking-head course video. rough-cut removes dead air, filler words, false starts and botched takes from raw footage, measuring real silence from audio levels rather than guessing. slide-cutout puts presentation slides on screen with the speaker as a circular corner cutout, timed from spoken cue phrases instead of hand-entered timestamps. Both hand back editable FCP7 XML timelines that Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve import, never a locked-off render. Runs entirely locally via Whisper, so footage never leaves the machine.
